description: recipe.first-draft 1.3.0 requires every ingredient line to state how much, in the line's own text. That requirement is the prompt's, and this harness never calls a model, so no fixture can show a model obeyed it; what this one fixes in place is the pipeline's answer for when one did not. A draft whose lines read 'plain flour, sifted' validates: the shape is sound, nothing here is repaired, and the gap is one the creator meets as a flag in the draft review screen and fixes by typing. Refusing the answer instead would throw away a whole draft over the part of it a creator can correct fastest, which is why no reason code is added for this and none should be.
